therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Change from baseline to Week 116 in CDR-SB

results.effect_size: Difference in adjusted mean CDR-SB = -0.31 (95% CI: -0.66 to 0.05)
results.target_engagement_evidence: Amyloid PET: difference in adjusted means = -66.44 centiloids (95% CI: -74.71 to -58.16), p<0.0001; CSF pTau-181 geometric mean percent change: gantenerumab -25.2% vs placebo +1.1%, p<0.001; CSF tTau: gantenerumab -16.6% vs placebo +3.2%, p<0.001; CSF neurogranin: gantenerumab -22.3% vs placebo -0.6%, p<0.001
biomarker_changes: Amyloid PET (centiloid): gantenerumab -57.38 vs placebo +9.06 (difference -66.44, p<0.0001)
CSF NFL: gantenerumab +12.1% vs placebo +15.8% (p=0.396, not significant)
Tau PET (temporal composite SUVR): gantenerumab +0.13 vs placebo +0.12 (difference +0.01, p=0.7816, not significant)
subgroup_findings: FAQ score showed nominally significant improvement: difference -0.86 (95% CI: -1.68 to -0.03), p=0.0425
ADAS-Cog13 trend toward improvement: difference -1.25 (95% CI: -2.52 to 0.02), p=0.0544
ADCS-ADL, MMSE, ADAS-Cog11, VFT, DSST, ADCS-iADL all non-significant
safety_signals: ARIA-E occurred in 105/503 gantenerumab participants vs 5/481 placebo participants
ARIA-H occurred in 40/503 gantenerumab participants vs 6/481 placebo participants
Injection-site reactions in 94/503 gantenerumab vs 43/481 placebo participants
Anti-drug antibodies detected in 10 gantenerumab participants
Trial terminated following pre-planned analysis of Graduate I & II showing lack of efficacy

context.duration: 116 weeks (DBT period); up to 131 weeks including follow-up
context.investigator_commentary: Decision to terminate development of Gantenerumab for treatment of prodromal/mild/early-stage Alzheimer's disease following results of a pre-planned analysis of the safety and efficacy of Gant in Graduate I & II (WN29922/WN39658).
